system.seating: Twin bucket seats + 9 executive bucket seats
system.notes:
Twin bucket seats in a separated cockpit for the pilots and deluxe leather lounge seats for nine. Speed 170/350 (cruise/maximum; the sheet holds the cruise figure). Acceleration is not printed. Access 1 + 1 standard. Economy 1.2 km per liter (VTOL: 0.75 km/liter). Fuel IC/1,520 liters. Storage 10 CF storage + 10 CF cargo. Landing/Takeoff VTOL/STOL. Street Index 2. Divide the Availability target number by 3 (round up) for the mercenary contact known as the Dealer (Fields of Fire p.81). Options: Full Communications Suite 5,000¥ (2 CF), Wet Bar 1,000¥ (2), Lavatory 10,000¥ (4), Kitchenette 8,000¥ (4), Entertainment System 5,000¥ (2), Rigger Control System 10,000¥ (6).

Corporate Security Handbook p.87.
